title: How to understand and work with Risk as an Aspiring Psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱之外还能赚取其他收入，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，例如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两届心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖金以及我自己的专属支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组智囊团、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南与梅森的慰劳品以及限时一对一教练奖金。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接我的奖金页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖金。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: I just wanted to start today's podcast episode by just giving you a little warning that it is going to cover risk.
sentences.zh: 我只想在今天的播客节目开始时给你们一个小小的警告，那就是它将涉及风险。

sentences.en: It's going to cover examples of how someone might pose a risk to themselves or to others.
sentences.zh: 它将涵盖某人可能对自己或他人构成风险的实例。

sentences.en: If you might find this triggering,
sentences.zh: 如果你可能会觉得这触景生情或难以承受，

sentences.en: then please take my permission and give yourself permission to listen to this at a time where you feel more robust and able to engage with the conversation.
sentences.zh: 那么请获得我的允许，并允许自己在你感觉状态更好、能够参与对话的时候再听。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide, and you'll be on your way with the Aspiring.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，就让这成为你的指南，你将在《有抱负的人》中走上正轨。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening and I hope you will find today's episode really useful.
sentences.zh: 感谢您的收听，希望您会觉得今天的节目非常有用。

sentences.en: This is another special request episode today, and you can make any special requests you might have for topics for the podcast by heading to my website,
sentences.zh: 今天是另一个特别点播节目，你可以通过访问我的网站提出你对播客主题的任何特别要求，

sentences.en: goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk
sentences.zh: goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk

sentences.en: and then there at the top of the page is information for how you can submit any requests that you might have.
sentences.zh: 然后在那里的页面顶部有关于你如何提交任何请求的信息。

sentences.en: Please do, because I want this to be super useful for you, and yeah, I want this to be user-led as well as just being generated by me,
sentences.zh: 请一定要这样做，因为我希望这对你超级有用，是的，我希望这是由用户主导的，而不仅仅是由我生成，

sentences.en: because, you know, knowing that you are recognising that I might have some useful stuff to teach you,
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，知道你认识到我可能有一些有用的东西可以教给你，

sentences.en: and you reaching out to me to ask for me to teach it to you is just the most incredible feeling.
sentences.zh: 而你向我伸出援手要求我教你，这是最不可思议的感觉。

sentences.en: So, yeah, thank you very much for all of the feedback that I've had and for continuing to listen.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，非常感谢大家的所有反馈以及继续收听。

sentences.en: It means a great deal.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大。

sentences.en: Just a little caveat before we begin to let you know that the risk I will be talking about is when someone is discussing perhaps risk for themselves or someone else.
sentences.zh: 在开始之前一个小小的注意事项，让你们知道我将要谈论的风险是当某人可能讨论对自己或他人的风险时。

sentences.en: But don't worry if you want some more tips on practical risk management, because that is coming up soon in an interview I'll be doing with a psychiatrist where we discuss
sentences.zh: 但如果你想要更多关于实用风险管理的提示，请不要担心，因为我即将与一位精神科医生进行采访，在采访中我们将讨论

sentences.en: how to kind of optimally prepare the environment and factors to consider about minimising risk to yourself, to colleagues and to clients too.
sentences.zh: 如何以最佳方式准备环境以及考虑将对自己、同事和客户的风险降到最低的因素。

sentences.en: It's also worth saying that when working with risk, it's really important to work collaboratively
sentences.zh: 还值得一提的是，在处理风险时，协同合作非常重要，

sentences.en: with your multidisciplinary team and, of course, with psychiatry and with supervisors and anybody else you might have on board as part of your team.
sentences.zh: 与你的多学科团队合作，当然还有精神病学、主管以及作为团队一部分可能参与的任何人。

sentences.en: So do take my advice in conjunction with your own best practice guidelines.
sentences.zh: 因此，请结合你自己的最佳实践指南采纳我的建议。

sentences.en: Okay, so no matter what area of psychology you are wanting to work in, it is likely that you will encounter risk and working with risk as you progress throughout your career.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以无论你想在心理学的哪个领域工作，随着你职业生涯的进展，你很可能会遇到风险以及与风险打交道。

sentences.en: It's certainly something that crops up for me daily in clinical practice, even if just to discuss it, you know, whether it's a current thing for clients or not.
sentences.zh: 这当然是我在临床实践中每天都会出现的事情，即使只是为了讨论它，你知道的，无论是客户目前的事情与否。

sentences.en: Now, of course, when we're working in services, risk can look like risk to themselves.
sentences.zh: 现在，当然，当我们在服务中工作时，风险可能表现为对自己的风险。

sentences.en: Risk can look like risk to others.
sentences.zh: 风险可能表现为对他人的风险。

sentences.en: It's not really the done thing to define a word by using the word, is it?
sentences.zh: 用一个词来定义这个词本身，这其实不太合适，对吧？

sentences.en: So let me define risk without using the word risk.
sentences.zh: 所以让我不用“风险”这个词来定义风险。

sentences.en: Okay, so risk might look like someone who wants to self-harm.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以风险可能看起来像一个想要自残的人。

sentences.en: It might look like self-harm that is superficial.
sentences.zh: 它可能看起来像是表面的自残。

sentences.en: It might look like self-harm that is more significant.
sentences.zh: 它可能看起来像是更严重的自残。

sentences.en: It might involve that they have, you know, perhaps a plan to end their own life.
sentences.zh: 它可能涉及他们，你知道的，也许有结束自己生命的计划。

sentences.en: You may also be party to information where they're saying that they want to harm someone else.
sentences.zh: 你也可能会获悉他们说想要伤害别人的信息。

sentences.en: And that might be in a forensic service, or it might be that you suspect that they are having some sort of psychotic episode, or some sort of change.
sentences.zh: 这可能是在法医服务中，或者你可能怀疑他们正在经历某种精神病发作，或某种改变。

sentences.en: So it might be that people are in, you know, perfect lucid thought, telling you that they think, you know, so-and-so is going to, you know, be hurt.
sentences.zh: 所以人们可能处于完全清醒的思维中，告诉你他们认为，你知道的，某某将会，你知道的，受到伤害。

sentences.en: And that, of course, is a significant event that needs to be recorded and needs to be handled with the client at the time.
sentences.zh: 而这当然是一个重大事件，需要记录下来，并且需要在当时与客户一起处理。

sentences.en: So, yeah, you might handle that in a number of different ways.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，你可能会用几种不同的方式来处理这个问题。

sentences.en: If you haven't already listened to episode eight of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast, then it might be useful for you to do that either before listening to this episode or after.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有听过《有抱负的心理学家》播客的第八集，那么在听这一集之前或之后听一下可能会对你有所帮助。

sentences.en: So episode eight is all about boundary setting as an aspiring psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 第八集是关于作为一名有抱负的心理学家的边界设定的。

sentences.en: And in that, I go through, you know, confidentiality and consent.
sentences.zh: 在其中，我探讨了，你知道的，保密和知情同意。

sentences.en: And that is also really useful stuff to draw upon.
sentences.zh: 这也是非常有用、可以借鉴的内容。

sentences.en: So I'm not going to go over all of that content again, because I don't want to, you know, duplicate what I've already said, because you won't find that useful.
sentences.zh: 所以我不会再重复所有这些内容，因为我不想，你知道的，重复我已经说过的话，因为你不会觉得那有用。

sentences.en: But I will pay lip service to what I've said.
sentences.zh: 但我会对我说过的话敷衍地提一下。

sentences.en: But you might well find it helpful to listen to episode eight if you haven't already, because that is going to be a more full account of what we're talking about here
sentences.zh: 但如果你还没听过，你可能会觉得听第八集很有帮助，因为那将是对我们这里谈论的内容的更全面的说明

sentences.en: with respect to confidentiality and consent.
sentences.zh: 关于保密和知情同意。

sentences.en: So, as you'll know, when we're working with people, we've already gone through our confidentiality and consent.
sentences.zh: 因此，正如你所知，当我们与人合作时，我们已经经历了保密和知情同意的程序。

sentences.en: And that is especially useful when you then get issues where risk is cropping up.
sentences.zh: 当你遇到风险出现的问题时，这一点尤其有用。

sentences.en: So if someone were to say that they, you know, wanted to hurt themselves or someone else, then you will then obviously respond appropriately in the moment.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果有人说他们，你知道的，想要伤害自己或他人，那么你显然会在当时做出适当的反应。

sentences.en: But also think with them about your, you know, your needing to keep themselves and others safe, and that they're aware that you have that duty of care to do that.
sentences.zh: 但也要和他们一起思考你，你知道的，需要保证他们和其他人安全，并且他们知道你有这样做的照顾义务。

sentences.en: But you've got that clinical responsibility that you've got to look after everybody to keep them safe.
sentences.zh: 但你有那种临床责任，你必须照顾每个人以保证他们的安全。

sentences.en: It's a big job, guys.
sentences.zh: 这是一项重任，伙计们。

sentences.en: It's a big job.
sentences.zh: 这是一项重任。

sentences.en: Let's take a moment, take a breath.
sentences.zh: 让我们花点时间，深吸一口气。

sentences.en: It is a big job, and it matters.
sentences.zh: 这是一项重任，而且很重要。

sentences.en: And what you're doing matters.
sentences.zh: 你正在做的事情很重要。

sentences.en: But we're here, we're in the moment, and the client has suggested that they want to hurt themselves or someone else.
sentences.zh: 但我们在这里，就在当下，而客户表示他们想要伤害自己或他人。

sentences.en: It can be useful to think about time frame.
sentences.zh: 考虑时间范围可能会有所帮助。

sentences.en: It can be useful, so if, for example, someone has said that they, you know, they've got a plan to end their own life,
sentences.zh: 这可能会有所帮助，所以如果，例如，有人说他们，你知道的，他们有结束自己生命的计划，

sentences.en: then it can be useful to think about, well, have you got a time frame for that?
sentences.zh: 那么考虑一下这个问题可能会有所帮助：嗯，你对此有什么时间范围吗？

sentences.en: Is that something that you've, you know, you've got set in mind for a particular time or a particular date?
sentences.zh: 这是不是你，你知道的，在心里为特定时间或特定日期设定的东西？

sentences.en: And they might well tell you, or they might well not.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会告诉你，也可能不会。

sentences.en: And when people are less wanting to share information, then it's more worrying.
sentences.zh: 当人们不太愿意分享信息时，这就更令人担忧了。

sentences.en: It can be more worrying.
sentences.zh: 这可能会更令人担忧。

sentences.en: Obviously, this is going to be a case-by-case example, and you will definitely need to access supervision of your own about this.
sentences.zh: 显然，这将是一个个案示例，你绝对需要就此获得你自己的监督。

sentences.en: So please don't just use this advice to formulate your plans, but it can be in mind, and especially if you're not yet in clinical practice,
sentences.zh: 所以请不要只用这个建议来制定你的计划，但它可以记在心里，特别是如果你还不在临床实践中，

sentences.en: it can be useful for you to think about, well, what would I do?
sentences.zh: 思考一下会很有用，嗯，我会怎么做？

sentences.en: What might I do?
sentences.zh: 我可能会做什么？

sentences.en: How could I handle that?
sentences.zh: 我该如何处理这个问题？

sentences.en: So that's my little caveat.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我的一点注意事项。

sentences.en: This is a guide, but you will obviously need to follow your own protocols and procedures and check in with your management and your supervisors.
sentences.zh: 这是一个指南，但你显然需要遵循你自己的协议和程序，并与你的管理层和主管核对。

sentences.en: So someone has told you that they've got a plan.
sentences.zh: 所以有人告诉你他们有一个计划。

sentences.en: They perhaps won't share with you what time frame it's going to be, but maybe they have shared with you the method,
sentences.zh: 他们可能不会与你分享这将是什么时间范围，但也许他们与你分享了方法，

sentences.en: and it's, you know, detailed enough that that feels worrying, you know, that feels scary.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，足够详细，让人感到担忧，你知道的，这让人感到害怕。

sentences.en: And it might be that if it involves harm to someone else, that they've shared with you details about what that might involve and what kind of time frame that might take as well.
sentences.zh: 如果它涉及对别人的伤害，他们可能已经与你分享了关于这可能涉及什么以及这可能需要什么样的时间范围的细节。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's tricky because you're going to be feeling all kinds of things going on.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这很棘手，因为你会感受到各种各样正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: You're going to be feeling, you know, pressure.
sentences.zh: 你会感受到，你知道的，压力。

sentences.en: You're going to be feeling, you know, the importance and the significance of getting this right.
sentences.zh: 你会感受到，你知道的，把这件事做对的重要性和重大意义。

sentences.en: When I was an aspiring psychologist, certainly sometimes when I was even working as a trainee psychologist, if somebody told me that they wanted to end their life,
sentences.zh: 当我是一个有抱负的心理学家时，当然有时候当我甚至作为见习心理学家工作时，如果有人告诉我他们想结束自己的生命，

sentences.en: then there might have been a tendency or a desire to run out of the room as soon as possible and kind of get psychiatry involved.
sentences.zh: 那么可能会有一种倾向或愿望，想尽快跑出房间，让精神病学介入。

sentences.en: But actually, we need to think about how that feels as a client communicating this painful information.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，我们需要考虑作为传达这些痛苦信息的客户，这会有什么感觉。

sentences.en: And actually, what can be really useful is to work through with the client,
sentences.zh: 实际上，真正有用的是与客户一起探讨，

sentences.en: you know, what they're thinking and what they're feeling, exploring a little bit about what might have contributed to the way they're feeling and why,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们在想什么，他们在感受什么，稍微探索一下可能导致他们这种感觉的原因以及为什么，

sentences.en: really try to help contain the person you're speaking to so that they feel like they have shared something with you that then feels safe.
sentences.zh: 真正努力帮助包容你正在与之对话的人，让他们觉得他们已经与你分享了感觉安全的事情。

sentences.en: It's not left them feeling over-vulnerable or overstretched.
sentences.zh: 这没有让他们感到过于脆弱或不堪重负。

sentences.en: How you respond and when you respond and with what flavour and tone of compassion and warmth and empathy and positive regard
sentences.zh: 你如何回应、什么时候回应，以及带着什么样色彩和语调的同情、温暖、移情和积极关注

sentences.en: really does matter, you know, if we are to run out of the room when someone tells us something like that,
sentences.zh: 真的非常重要，你知道的，如果当有人告诉我们这样的话时我们要跑出房间，

sentences.en: then it might actually lead the client to feeling that their problems are too big to cope with
sentences.zh: 那么这实际上可能会导致客户觉得他们的问题太大而无法应对

sentences.en: or that it might lead to them feeling even more, you know, unsafe or, you know, less contained.
sentences.zh: 或者这可能会导致他们感到更加，你知道的，缺乏安全感，或者，你知道的，更少被包容。

sentences.en: And when people are not contained, you know, what we know is that they're going to be acting from more from a point of, you know, the red area of their window of tolerance.
sentences.zh: 当人们没有被包容时，你知道的，我们所知道的是，他们会更多地从，你知道的，他们的耐受窗口的红色区域采取行动。

sentences.en: They're not going to be able to engage their soothing and calming thoughts, you know.
sentences.zh: 他们将无法调动他们的安抚和平静的想法，你知道的。

sentences.en: They're going to be all out of whack.
sentences.zh: 他们会完全崩溃的。

sentences.en: And, you know, logical thought with compassion on their side is not going to be, you know, firing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，站在他们一边的带有同情心的逻辑思考将不会，你知道的，发挥作用。

sentences.en: OK, so what we're wanting to do is we're wanting to help the client feel heard, seen, valid, important.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以我们想要做的是，我们要帮助客户感到被倾听、被看到、被认可、很重要。

sentences.en: We don't want to be running away.
sentences.zh: 我们不想逃跑。

sentences.en: We're going to break for a quick break here and I'll be back afterwards to talk with you more about how we can recognise and work with risk as aspiring psychologists.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里做一个简短的休息，之后我会回来跟你们多聊聊作为有抱负的心理学家，我们如何识别和应对风险。

sentences.en: I'm Max and I work as an assistant psychologist in the Learning Disability Service in West Yorkshire.
sentences.zh: 我是马克斯，我在西约克郡的残疾服务部门担任助理心理学家。

sentences.en: Like most people working in psychology, I'm slowly but surely working myself up to that seemingly impossible goal of getting on to the clinical doctorate.
sentences.zh: 就像大多数从事心理学工作的人一样，我正在慢慢但肯定地朝着攻读临床博士学位这个看似不可能的目标努力。

sentences.en: With that end goal in mind, I thought I'd have a look at what's out there and see what books might be helpful for this.
sentences.zh: 带着这个最终目标，我想我应该看看外面有什么，看看哪些书对此会有所帮助。

sentences.en: I came across Marion's book, The Clinical Psychologist Collective, and decided that this would be a great buy for me to help me on my journey.
sentences.zh: 我遇到了玛丽安的书《临床心理学家集体》，并决定这对我来说是一次很棒的购买，可以帮助我的旅程。

sentences.en: I found Marion's book really informative and most insightful.
sentences.zh: 我发现玛丽安的书信息量很大，而且最有见地。

sentences.en: I especially liked how the stories reassured me that you don't need to be academically perfect to become a psychologist
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢这些故事如何向我保证，你不需要在学术上完美就能成为一名心理学家

sentences.en: and that as long as you have good interpersonal skills, such as compassion and empathy, you will get there.
sentences.zh: 并且只要你拥有良好的软技能，比如同情心和同理心，你就会成功的。

sentences.en: I would highly recommend this book to all aspiring psychologists and also those who want to know a bit more about the world of clinical psychology
sentences.zh: 我强烈推荐这本书给所有有抱负的心理学家，也推荐给那些想对临床心理学世界了解更多

sentences.en: and maybe want to work in that field one day.
sentences.zh: 并且可能希望有一天在该领域工作的人。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: So before we broke, we were thinking about what risk is, what it might look like, what it might involve and how we can try to optimally respond.
sentences.zh: 所以在我们休息之前，我们一直在思考什么是风险、它可能是什么样子、它可能涉及什么以及我们如何才能做出最佳反应。

sentences.en: It's important that you are able to get information about what people are telling you because it might be that you need to communicate that accurately to other services as well.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，你要能够获取人们告诉你的信息，因为你可能也需要将这些信息准确地传达给其他服务机构。

sentences.en: It might be that you are going to need to summon an ambulance or you are going to need to summon police, coast guard.
sentences.zh: 你可能需要叫救护车，或者你需要叫警察、海岸警卫队。

sentences.en: You know, it might be that you need to call the railways emergency line.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你可能需要拨打铁路紧急热线。

sentences.en: Is it transport police?
sentences.zh: 是交通警察吗？

sentences.en: I think it's transport police, but a quick Google will reveal who the right people to contact are.
sentences.zh: 我认为是交通警察，但快速谷歌一下就会揭晓谁是正确联系的人。

sentences.en: I believe there's a specific telephone line for if someone has suggested that they are going to attempt to end their own life on the railway.
sentences.zh: 我相信有一个专门的电话号码，如果有人暗示他们将试图在铁路结束自己的生命。

sentences.en: And what I will do is I will try and dig that out and put that in the show notes for you.
sentences.zh: 我会做的是，我会尽量把它找出来，并把它放在节目简介里给你。

sentences.en: When I was working in the NHS, we were given like a little card to have all our keys, which gave the number, but it snapped off.
sentences.zh: 当我在NHS工作时，我们拿到了像一张可以挂在我们所有钥匙上的小卡片，上面有号码，但它断掉了。

sentences.en: And so I don't have it anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有它了。

sentences.en: But there is a specific number that you can call.
sentences.zh: 但有一个你可以拨打的特定号码。

sentences.en: So I will try my best to get hold of that.
sentences.zh: 所以我将尽我最大努力去获取它。

sentences.en: Yeah, pop it in your diary because it might be really useful.
sentences.zh: 是的，把它记在你的日记里，因为这可能真的很有用。

sentences.en: So I have always, when working in clinical roles at the front of my diary, I have had important numbers, including the crisis team, including Samaritans, including, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我在临床角色中一直，在我的日记本扉页，我都有重要的号码，包括危机团队、包括撒玛利亚会、包括，你知道的，

sentences.en: numbers such as, you know, transport police.
sentences.zh: 诸如，你知道的，交通警察之类的号码。

sentences.en: And, you know, any relevant people in your area that help in crisis situations, because it really could make the difference.
sentences.zh: 并且，你知道的，你所在地区在危机情况下提供帮助的任何相关人员，因为这真的可以起到改变作用。

sentences.en: If you're having to scrabble around and look for a number in a moment where actually there isn't much time, it's much better to be able to open up your diary,
sentences.zh: 如果你在其实没有多少时间的时候不得不翻找一个号码，能够打开你的日记本要好得多，

sentences.en: get to where you need to be and respond.
sentences.zh: 到达你需要去的地方并做出反应。

sentences.en: So take a little bit of moment, especially if you're setting up a new diary for the year or you're setting up in a new role.
sentences.zh: 所以花一点时间，特别是如果你正在为今年建立新日记本或正在担任新角色。

sentences.en: You know, get a little bit of an idea of what do I do if the worst happens?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，对如果最坏的情况发生我该怎么办有一点概念？

sentences.en: What do I do if something happens that means that I need to take immediate safeguarding actions?
sentences.zh: 如果发生了一些事情意味着我需要采取立即的保障行动，我该怎么办？

sentences.en: So it might be that you've got your local adult or child safeguarding contact details in your important phone number section.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会把当地的成人或儿童保障联络方式放在你的重要电话号码部分。

sentences.en: They would be very useful ones for you to have indeed.
sentences.zh: 这些确实是对你非常有用的人。

sentences.en: So, yeah, a little bit of time in advance of when you're going to need this information is absolutely time well spent, in my opinion.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，在你需要这些信息之前花一点时间绝对是明智的时间投资，在我看来。

sentences.en: When we are getting to know clients, it can be useful to think about screening for risk.
sentences.zh: 当我们了解客户时，考虑筛查风险可能会有所帮助。

sentences.en: So there are, of course, specific screening measures that you can use.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，有你可以使用的特定筛查方法。

sentences.en: I tend to, when it's generic, just use the core outcome measure because it does screen for risk and it will tell you whether someone is clinically significant for risk or not.
sentences.zh: 当它是通用的时候，我倾向于只使用核心结果测量，因为它确实会筛查风险，并且它会告诉你某人在临床上是否有显著的风险。

sentences.en: So that's a really useful place to start.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常好的起点。

sentences.en: But, of course, things like the GAD-7 and the PHQ-9, they also screen a little bit for risk as well.
sentences.zh: 但是，当然，像GAD-7和PHQ-9这样的东西，它们也稍微筛查了一点风险。

sentences.en: But, yeah, it's an idea to monitor risk.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，监控风险是一个想法。

sentences.en: So, you know, it can be useful to do before, during and after measures.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，做之前、期间和之后的测量可能会很有用。

sentences.en: So your before might happen at assessment.
sentences.zh: 所以你的之前可能发生在评估时。

sentences.en: Your during might happen, you know, at the point that you start therapy or mid-therapy.
sentences.zh: 你的期间可能发生在你，你知道的，开始治疗时或治疗中期。

sentences.en: And then depending on how long your intervention is, you might want to repeat those measures as well and then obviously have measures again at the close.
sentences.zh: 然后根据你的干预持续时间，你可能还想重复这些测量，然后显然在结束时再次进行测量。

sentences.en: But what we'd be hoping for is that with whatever brilliant work that you and your team are doing, that their well-being improves, their problems decrease, their functioning,
sentences.zh: 但我们希望的是，通过你和你的团队正在做的任何出色工作，他们的幸福感得到改善，他们的问题减少，他们的功能

sentences.en: their functioning gets better.
sentences.zh: 他们的机能有所改善。

sentences.en: And, of course, their risk decreases.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们的风险也随之降低。

sentences.en: That is, you know, the gold standard for what I would think of as a piece of work well done indeed.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，你知道，这堪称我心目中真正大功告成的黄金标准。

sentences.en: And, of course, you know, what we've covered in the boundary setting episode of the podcast is, well, what happens if it's only really after you have the session that you,
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道的，我们在播客的设定边界那一集里讨论过，嗯，如果是在你面谈结束之后，

sentences.en: you know, your cog start whirring or you piece together something that you hadn't really picked up on in the session or you suddenly think, well, actually,
sentences.zh: 你知道，你的大脑开始飞速运转，或者你把一些在面谈中没有真正注意到的事情拼凑在了一起，或者你突然觉得，嗯，实际上，

sentences.en: now I've discussed that with my supervisor.
sentences.zh: 现在我和我的督导讨论过这件事了。

sentences.en: That does feel a lot riskier than I felt it was at the time.
sentences.zh: 这确实比我当时感觉到的风险要大得多。

sentences.en: You know, what do we do then?
sentences.zh: 你知道，那我们该怎么办呢？

sentences.en: And it might be that you're needing to access safeguarding or refer to safeguarding or activate, you know, a keep safe plan without getting hold of the client if, in fact,
sentences.zh: 而且你可能需要诉诸保障机制，或者转介至保障机制，或者启动，你知道的，一个安全保持计划，即使事实上你没能联系到客户，

sentences.en: you haven't been able to get hold of them.
sentences.zh: 如果你确实没能联系到他们的话。

sentences.en: And if you haven't been able to get hold of them, that's further evidence that we need to put our keep safe plan in place.
sentences.zh: 如果你没能联系到他们，这便成了我们需要落实安全保持计划的进一步证据。

sentences.en: Now, most services that I am aware of ought to have care plans.
sentences.zh: 好了，据我所知，大多数服务机构都应该有护理计划。

sentences.en: So it's hopefully something that you're familiar with and it might be something that all of your multidisciplinary team feed into as well.
sentences.zh: 所以希望这是你所熟悉的内容，而且这也可能是你的所有多学科团队成员都会参与制定的内容。

sentences.en: So there might be care planning elements from psychiatry.
sentences.zh: 因此，其中可能会包含来自精神病学的护理计划要素。

sentences.en: There might be care planning elements from a care coordinator or from, you know, occupational therapy, for example.
sentences.zh: 也可能会包含来自护理协调员或者例如来自作业治疗的护理计划要素。

sentences.en: And you might well be able to feed into that as well with any work that you've been doing.
sentences.zh: 而你很可能也能把自己所做过的工作融入其中。

sentences.en: So care planning is where we are getting a sense of what might be useful and how we're going to achieve that.
sentences.zh: 因此，护理计划是我们用来明确什么可能会有用以及我们将如何实现它的过程。

sentences.en: But elements of risk would be covered there as well.
sentences.zh: 但其中也会涵盖风险的要素。

sentences.en: And in your individual trust or environment, there will likely be risk screening tools and risk screening measures that go into the care planning process.
sentences.zh: 并且在你所在的信托机构或工作环境中，很可能会有风险筛查工具和风险筛查措施纳入护理计划的制定流程中。

sentences.en: So trying to think what the name of my clinical note software was called in the NHS, it was either Epex or Lorenzo.
sentences.zh: 我在努力回想我在NHS时的临床记录软件叫什么名字，要么是Epex，要么是Lorenzo。

sentences.en: And I can't for the life of me, I think it was Epex, the most recent one, said just under a year ago, you know, fallen straight out of my head.
sentences.zh: 我绞尽脑汁也想不起来了，我觉得是Epex，最近用的那个，大概不到一年前吧，你知道的，从我脑子里忘得精光。

sentences.en: Or was it care notes?
sentences.zh: 还是叫Care Notes？

sentences.en: I think it was care notes.
sentences.zh: 我想是叫Care Notes。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think there's three different genesis is there of Epex, Lorenzo and care notes.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我想Epex、Lorenzo和Care Notes有这三个不同的版本来源吧。

sentences.en: And I've also used Rio as well.
sentences.zh: 而且我也用过Rio。

sentences.en: But these clinical notes systems will often have, you know, ways to to specifically screen for and manage risk.
sentences.zh: 但这些临床记录系统通常会提供，你知道的，专门用于筛查和管理风险的方法。

sentences.en: So do check out your organizational practices as well.
sentences.zh: 所以也请务必了解你们机构的做法。

sentences.en: But to summarize, you know, what we've done in today's podcast episode is we've thought about risk to selves, risk to others and ways to manage, record and monitor that risk.
sentences.zh: 但总而言之，你知道的，我们在今天的播客节目中所做的是，我们探讨了对自身的风险、对他人的风险，以及管理、记录和监测这些风险的方法。

sentences.en: It's also useful to think about whether self-harm always means, you know, suicide.
sentences.zh: 思考自残是否总是意味着，你知道，自杀，这也是很有用的。

sentences.en: And when we're working with adolescent population and when we're working with parents of adolescents, sometimes it can be helpful to just separate those two actions a little bit.
sentences.zh: 当我们与青少年群体以及青少年的父母合作时，有时把这两种行为稍微区分开来会很有帮助。

sentences.en: So if you've got a young person who's cutting, for example, but cutting in a superficial way, then it doesn't always necessarily equate that that client is suicidal.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你有一个正在自残的年轻人，比如割腕，但只是表面的割伤，那么这并不一定等同于该客户有自杀倾向。

sentences.en: So sometimes it can be useful to, you know, with the client's consent, share that with the family.
sentences.zh: 因此，有时在征得客户同意的情况下，把这一点告知家属会很有用，你知道的。

sentences.en: You know, actually, the client the client has told me or, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，实际上，客户——客户已经告诉我了，或者，你知道的，

sentences.en: you might you might I've sometimes fed that back with a young person in the room at the same time as their parent.
sentences.zh: 你可能会——我有时会在年轻人及其父母同时在场的情况下，把这个情况反馈给他们。

sentences.en: And actually, you know, so and so is not suicidal.
sentences.zh: 实际上，你知道的，某某并没有自杀倾向。

sentences.en: They're not feeling suicidal, but they are feeling, you know, a bit lost or a bit wobbly.
sentences.zh: 他们没有感到想自杀，但他们确实感到，你知道的，有点迷茫或者有点动摇。

sentences.en: And they're finding that this helps them have some control at the moment.
sentences.zh: 而且他们发现这能帮助他们在目前获得一些控制感。

sentences.en: And of course, what we want to do is move towards being able to learn skills to, you know, ameliorate this distress, you know, so that they can have control in different ways.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们想要做的是朝着能够学习技能以，你知道的，缓解这种痛苦的方向努力，你知道的，这样他们就能以不同的方式获得控制感。

sentences.en: So, you know, sometimes having that conversation with people can be useful.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，有时与人们进行这样的对话是很有用的。

sentences.en: And of course, what we know is that people who do self-harm are more likely to go on to have, you know, suicidal thoughts or intentions.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们所知道的是，确实有自残行为的人更有可能进一步产生，你知道的，自杀的想法或意图。

sentences.en: But it's not always the case.
sentences.zh: 但这并非总是如此。

sentences.en: So, you know, we can't be resting on our laurels here and guaranteeing that, you know, that someone is not going to become suicidal.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我们不能在这里高枕无忧，保证说，你知道的，某人不会产生自杀倾向。

sentences.en: But currently at the point of assessment, if that is indeed what you are assessing, it looks like there is no suicidal intent currently.
sentences.zh: 但在评估的当下，如果这确实是你在评估的内容，目前看起来并没有自杀意图。

sentences.en: Oh, people, this is big stuff, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 哦，各位，这可是大事，不是吗？

sentences.en: This is important stuff.
sentences.zh: 这是重要的事情。

sentences.en: And you are out there doing this work or you will be in future.
sentences.zh: 而你们正在从事这项工作，或者将来会从事。

sentences.en: And it matters, you know, it matters to you.
sentences.zh: 而且这很重要，你知道的，这对你很重要。

sentences.en: It matters to clients that you may be working with currently.
sentences.zh: 这对你目前可能正在合作的客户很重要。

sentences.en: It matters to clients who you may not even have met yet.
sentences.zh: 这对你可能甚至还没见过的客户很重要。

sentences.en: It matters to clients who may be out there living their best life right now.
sentences.zh: 这对那些现在可能正在过着他们最精彩生活的客户很重要。

sentences.en: But when they need you, you will be there.
sentences.zh: 但当他们需要你时，你会在那里。

sentences.en: And you will have that theory and practice ready to roll to help make that difference.
sentences.zh: 而且你将准备好随时应用这些理论与实践，来帮助带来改变。

sentences.en: And that is so incredible.
sentences.zh: 这真是太不可思议了。

sentences.en: Well done to you.
sentences.zh: 你们做得真棒。

sentences.en: And thank you for listening to this episode.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们收听本期节目。

sentences.en: I hope you find it useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你们觉得它有用。

sentences.en: Like I said, it was a special requeSt.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，这是一个特别的要求。

sentences.en: So if you've got any special requests of your own, then do go and check out the podcast section of my website,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你有任何自己的特殊要求，请务必去查看我网站上的播客板块，

sentences.en: goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk forward slash podcast to submit your special requests.
sentences.zh: goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk斜杠podcast以提交你的特殊要求。

sentences.en: I hope you find the upcoming information on the compassionate Q&A.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得即将发布的关于富有同情心的问答的信息很有用。

sentences.en: You can watch, depending on when you're listening to this, you can definitely watch the first one.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看，取决于你是什么时候听这期节目的，你绝对可以观看第一期。

sentences.en: And by the time this comes out, you might well be able to watch the second one on replay as well.
sentences.zh: 等到这期节目发布时，你很可能也可以观看第二期的回放了。

sentences.en: The easiest way to do that is by heading to Good Thinking Psychological Services on YouTube whilst you're there.
sentences.zh: 最简单的方法就是前往YouTube上的“Good Thinking Psychological Services”，趁你在那儿的时候，

sentences.en: Be rude not to.
sentences.zh: 不点个赞就说不过去了。

sentences.en: You might as well like and subscribe, you know, subscribe to the channel, like all the videos, fling a few comments in.
sentences.zh: 你不妨点个赞并订阅，你知道的，订阅频道，给所有视频点赞，顺便留几条评论。

sentences.en: It would be so welcomed.
sentences.zh: 那将是非常受欢迎的。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 谢谢收听。

sentences.en: And I hope you find the content useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得内容有用。

sentences.en: I'll look forward to catching up with you next week.
sentences.zh: 我期待着下周与你相聚。

sentences.en: Don't forget that new episodes land at 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 别忘了新节目在每周一

sentences.en: on a Monday, UK time.
sentences.zh: 英国时间早上6点上线。

sentences.en: So subscribe via podcast channels and that's when they'll drop into your podcast library.
sentences.zh: 所以通过播客频道订阅，它们就会在那时推送到你的播客库中。

sentences.en: Or just go searching for them at 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 或者在周一早上6点

sentences.en: on a Monday.
sentences.zh: 直接去搜索它们。

sentences.en: And be hot off the press.
sentences.zh: 抢先获取最新内容。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Have a lovely day, whatever you're up to.
sentences.zh: 无论你在忙什么，祝你拥有美好的一天。

sentences.en: And again, thank you for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Thank you again for being part of my world and for listening right to the end.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你成为我世界的一部分并一直收听到底。

sentences.en: We've just got a little bit coming up about the Compassionate Q&A series.
sentences.zh: 我们接下来将有一小段关于“富有同情心问答”系列的内容。

sentences.en: And then you can enjoy the jingle.
sentences.zh: 然后你就可以欣赏片头音乐了。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: And like I said, if you'd like to get involved with your own story for the aspiring Psychologist
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，如果你想为有志心理学家集体贡献你自己的故事，

sentences.en: Collective, then do check out the details in the show notes for how you can request more information.
sentences.zh: 请务必查看节目说明中的详细信息，了解如何获取更多信息。

sentences.en: But if you head to my website, which is goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk and then head to my books, there will be information there for you.
sentences.zh: 但如果你前往我的网站，即goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk，然后点击我的书籍，那里会有相关信息供你参考。

sentences.en: Being well supported during any interview season is so important.
sentences.zh: 在任何面试季期间获得良好的支持都是非常重要的。

sentences.en: I have therefore planned some compassionate question and answer support sessions for you.
sentences.zh: 因此，我为你规划了一些富有同情心的问答支持环节。

sentences.en: You are absolutely welcome to come along to all of them.
sentences.zh: 非常欢迎你参加所有这些环节。

sentences.en: Some of them, none of them.
sentences.zh: 参加其中几个，或者一个都不参加也行。

sentences.en: No need to book.
sentences.zh: 无需预约。

sentences.zh: 以下是给你的日期安排：

sentences.zh: 2月28日星期一，晚上7:30。

sentences.en: Monday, the 21st of March, 7.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 3月21日星期一，晚上7:30。

sentences.en: Monday, the 4th of April, 7.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 4月4日星期一，晚上7:30。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast, that's your side.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客，这就是你的坚实后盾。

sentences.en: You'll be on your wish to aspire with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 你将在玛丽安·特伦特博士的陪伴下，在追求理想的道路上前进。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你能通过超越出卖时间来赚取金钱，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，临床心理学家，我自2019年以来一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One2Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可规模化的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的成长之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外奖励以及我专属的支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组头脑风暴大师班、大师课、个性化指导、一份福特姆与梅森的犒赏，以及限时的一对一教练指导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
